stories.title: South African jurist Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
stories.reason: The former UN human rights chief, who led the UN commission that concluded Israel committed genocide in Gaza, was honored for her decades of work promoting peace and international law, with the award ceremony set for December 10 in Oslo.

stories.title: Trump sanctions the entire International Criminal Court hours after the Nobel announcement, and Netanyahu welcomes the move
stories.reason: The sanctions target the court over its arrest warrant for Netanyahu, drawing condemnation from the ICC and a pledge of support from the EU, in a move critics linked to the timing of Navi Pillay's Peace Prize win for her Gaza genocide findings.

stories.title: An ICE agent shoots a man in front of his young son in New York's Marble Hill, sparking protests
stories.reason: Mayor Mamdani said a two-hour standoff with Trump administration officials failed to secure the release of Oscar Belgal, who was shot in the neck with his 5-year-old son in the car, before ICE drove him away, prompting condemnation from Governor Hochul and protests outside the hospital.

stories.title: OpenAI discloses it disrupted Russian and Iranian covert influence operations built on ChatGPT
stories.reason: A Russian network used a fake research center to target Ukraine's reputation while an Iranian operation deployed seven fabricated Western journalist personas to plant roughly 100 articles, marking the first time OpenAI has publicly rated disrupted campaigns at its highest severity levels.

stories.title: Delta Air Lines posts its first earnings miss in two years and slashes its 2026 profit outlook
stories.reason: A roughly $6 billion jump in annual fuel costs pushed Delta to cut full-year adjusted earnings guidance to $5.10-$5.60 a share from $6.50-$7.50 and slash its free-cash-flow forecast, even as revenue still grew 16% year over year.

stories.title: Nvidia-backed Firmus withdraws its roughly $5 billion Australian IPO, citing market conditions
stories.reason: The AI data center operator's board scrapped what would have been a landmark ASX listing after investors balked at a valuation nearly triple its August funding round, with concerns over its debt load and unproven construction track record; the company now plans to raise private capital instead.

stories.title: GlobalFoundries signs a $2 billion deal with rival TSMC to make advanced chip-packaging components in the US
stories.reason: Under the five-year agreement, GlobalFoundries will produce silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging system at its Malta, New York plant starting in 2028, creating what the company calls the first US-based source for a critical AI chip component.

stories.title: Thailand's opposition files a no-confidence motion against PM Anutin Charnvirakul and 17 other ministers
stories.reason: The 145-lawmaker motion targets ministers solely from coalition partner Bhumjaithai's cabinet quota over alleged corruption and a push to consolidate power, with Anutin saying the debate is effectively against his entire government and expected to run three to four days in late October.
